title: Miband 4 - Feature Request: Bluetooth Connection Status
body:
Hello,
I like to suggest the following change on how the Bluetooth status (between phone and band) is indicated. With the current design (xDrip+ 2020.05.05) the Bluetooth connection lost symbol is in the upper right corner.

It's easy to miss up there while just focusing on the BG values. I would prefer if the symbol would be moved down to the BG information area and if it would be bigger. Could you set the BG trend arrow picture to be switched out with the lost BT symbol in case of a lost connection? It is very visible there and it would only affect the design/appearance in cases of a lost connection.

Optional (should be possible to switch on and off in settings)
A vibration alarm on the band when the BT connection is lost. There are two ways to implement this:
1. Use the alarm clock function. The app sets an alarm that is due in 15min. On each connection the app moves the alarm time back. Normally this alarm will never trigger. In case the connection is lost for 15min the alarm triggers.
2. Use calendar and move the appointment along with every connection similar to the alarm clock approach.

The pro for the alarm clock is that the vibration alarm is more intense and it is repeated after 10 min if ignored. The challenge is how to separate the app alarm from user alarms (maybe use only uneven minutes for app alarm). The calendar approach only vibrates very briefly and there is no reminder. But you can set a custom text and there will be a note in notifications.
(I checked that the alarm clock and calendar work independent from the phone after they are set.)

**Summary:**
- More visible BT connection lost symbol
- Vibrate on BT connection loss with alarm clock approach  --or--
- Vibrate on BT connection loss with calendar approach

This is how it could look:
![blue](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/65522328/82271633-a44f3100-9978-11ea-8229-022b01528533.jpg)

I am happy to hear your thoughts about my request @ All and @bigdigital.
